crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD top-divergence armed two 90-DTE Collars ahead of the peak ($110.64 on 6/01 and $112.73 on 7/23). crisis_windows.title_zh: 2018-Q4 美联储缩表加息急跌 (-22.7%)

On 10/11 when VIX/VIX3M inverted to 1.109, the option sleeve monetized for +$5,847 (+34.18 QQQ shares), reducing QQQ's -22.69% drawdown to -21.28% (+1.41% excess) while holding 100% QQQ.

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, U1 held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up) and stayed strictly 100% QQQ with ATH<=5% freeze, capturing 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (0.00% excess).
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 零前视客观披露：2020年2月见顶前宏观基本面仅亮 2/6 灯且全美 AD 创历史新高，纯内生宽度/宏观开关未提前挂 Put（也因此零损耗吃满 2019 年 +39% 主升浪）；下跌超 5% 后触发低位铁律冻结，100% 满仓 QQQ 完整吃下 3/23 后的 V 型暴涨（区间超额 0.00%）。

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2022 加息慢熊（QQQ -35.1% vs U1 -31.5% · 后半程 5x 止盈锁利）
crisis_windows.narrative_en: In 2022's frog-boiling grind, VIX/VIX3M peaked at just 1.022 (<1.10), so panic-inversion TP never fired. Track-2 Dual-TP (DTE<=45 & Put>=5x) stepped in on 2022-02-24 Open @$318.84 (32 DTE left, 5x+ deep ITM), harvesting +$37,680 (+121.86 extra QQQ shares!) right before March's dead-cat bounce, slashing 2022 MDD from -35.12% to -31.52% (+3.60% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 2022 温水煮青蛙慢熊中 VIX/VIX3M 全年最高仅 1.022（未达 1.10 恐慌倒挂）；第二轨「后半程 DTE<=45 且 Put>=5x」精准补位：在 2022-02-24 早盘 @$318.84（距到期 32 天、深实值超 5 倍）果断兑现 +$37,680（低位抄底 +121.86 股 QQQ），完美避开 3 月底反弹归零，100% 满仓将 2022 回撤从 -35.12% 砍至 -31.52%（超额 +3.60%）！

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2024-08 日元套息交易平仓闪崩 (-13.6%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD divergence opened two 50% option slots right into the summer peak ($455.50 on 5/30 and $497.62 on 7/16). When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!

Even with macro lights at only 2/6, US Liquid AD Line < 50DMA top-divergence caught the $539.52 top and opened a 50% Collar on 2025-02-24 @$527.88 (K_P=$475.09). On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 即便宏观灯仅亮 2 盏，全美 AD Line < 50DMA 顶背离依然死死咬住 $539.52 大顶，于 2/24 @$527.88 开启 50% 保护（K_P=$475.09）；4/07 关税恐慌极值（倒挂 1.234）在 $408.66 铁底单笔暴赚 +$76,729，一把抄底 +187.70 股 QQQ，回撤压至 -16.36%（超额高达 +6.41%）！

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD top-divergence armed two 90-DTE Collars ahead of the peak ($110.64 on 6/01 and $112.73 on 7/23). On 2015-08-24 when VIX/VIX3M spiked to 1.194, both tranches monetized at $94.23 Open for +$13,633 (+144.6 QQQ shares), cutting QQQ's -13.94% drawdown nearly in half.

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2018-Q4 美联储缩表加息急跌 (-22.7%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights fired 47 trading days before the top (Slot 1 Naked Put 6/25, Slot 2 Collar 7/26, refreshed Collar 10/05 @$182.36). On 10/11 when VIX/VIX3M inverted to 1.109, the option sleeve monetized for +$5,847 (+34.18 QQQ shares), reducing QQQ's -22.69% drawdown to -21.28% (+1.41% excess) while holding 100% QQQ.
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 四灯在见顶前 47 个交易日提前亮起，10/05 在 $182.36 高位补齐 Collar；10/11 首波恐慌倒挂 1.109 止盈落袋 +$5,847（增持 +34.18 股 QQQ），全程 100% 持仓 QQQ 将回撤从 -22.69% 压至 -21.28%（超额 +1.41%）。

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, U1 held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up) and stayed strictly 100% QQQ with ATH<=5% freeze, capturing 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (0.00% excess).
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 零前视客观披露：2020年2月见顶前宏观基本面仅亮 2/6 灯且全美 AD 创历史新高，纯内生宽度/宏观开关未提前挂 Put（也因此零损耗吃满 2019 年 +39% 主升浪）；下跌超 5% 后触发低位铁律冻结，100% 满仓 QQQ 完整吃下 3/23 后的 V 型暴涨（区间超额 0.00%）。

Track-2 Dual-TP (DTE<=45 & Put>=5x) stepped in on 2022-02-24 Open @$318.84 (32 DTE left, 5x+ deep ITM), harvesting +$37,680 (+121.86 extra QQQ shares!) right before March's dead-cat bounce, slashing 2022 MDD from -35.12% to -31.52% (+3.60% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 2022 温水煮青蛙慢熊中 VIX/VIX3M 全年最高仅 1.022（未达 1.10 恐慌倒挂）；第二轨「后半程 DTE<=45 且 Put>=5x」精准补位：在 2022-02-24 早盘 @$318.84（距到期 32 天、深实值超 5 倍）果断兑现 +$37,680（低位抄底 +121.86 股 QQQ），完美避开 3 月底反弹归零，100% 满仓将 2022 回撤从 -35.12% 砍至 -31.52%（超额 +3.60%）！

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2024-08 日元套息交易平仓闪崩 (-13.6%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD divergence opened two 50% option slots right into the summer peak ($455.50 on 5/30 and $497.62 on 7/16). When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!

Even with macro lights at only 2/6, US Liquid AD Line < 50DMA top-divergence caught the $539.52 top and opened a 50% Collar on 2025-02-24 @$527.88 (K_P=$475.09). On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 即便宏观灯仅亮 2 盏，全美 AD Line < 50DMA 顶背离依然死死咬住 $539.52 大顶，于 2/24 @$527.88 开启 50% 保护（K_P=$475.09）；4/07 关税恐慌极值（倒挂 1.234）在 $408.66 铁底单笔暴赚 +$76,729，一把抄底 +187.70 股 QQQ，回撤压至 -16.36%（超额高达 +6.41%）！

On 10/11 when VIX/VIX3M inverted to 1.109, the option sleeve monetized for +$5,847 (+34.18 QQQ shares), reducing QQQ's -22.69% drawdown to -21.28% (+1.41% excess) while holding 100% QQQ.

On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, U1 held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up) and stayed strictly 100% QQQ with ATH<=5% freeze, capturing 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (0.00% excess).

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2024-08 日元套息交易平仓闪崩 (-13.6%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD divergence opened two 50% option slots right into the summer peak ($455.50 on 5/30 and $497.62 on 7/16). When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!

Even with macro lights at only 2/6, US Liquid AD Line < 50DMA top-divergence caught the $539.52 top and opened a 50% Collar on 2025-02-24 @$527.88 (K_P=$475.09). On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 即便宏观灯仅亮 2 盏，全美 AD Line < 50DMA 顶背离依然死死咬住 $539.52 大顶，于 2/24 @$527.88 开启 50% 保护（K_P=$475.09）；4/07 关税恐慌极值（倒挂 1.234）在 $408.66 铁底单笔暴赚 +$76,729，一把抄底 +187.70 股 QQQ，回撤压至 -16.36%（超额高达 +6.41%）！

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD top-divergence armed two 90-DTE Collars ahead of the peak ($110.64 on 6/01 and $112.73 on 7/23). On 2015-08-24 when VIX/VIX3M spiked to 1.194, both tranches monetized at $94.23 Open for +$13,633 (+144.6 QQQ shares), cutting QQQ's -13.94% drawdown nearly in half.

crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights fired 47 trading days before the top (Slot 1 Naked Put 6/25, Slot 2 Collar 7/26, refreshed Collar 10/05 @$182.36). On 10/11 when VIX/VIX3M inverted to 1.109, the option sleeve monetized for +$5,847 (+34.18 QQQ shares), reducing QQQ's -22.69% drawdown to -21.28% (+1.41% excess) while holding 100% QQQ.

crisis_windows.narrative_en: Honest out-of-sample disclosure: because COVID-19 was an exogenous biological shock while pre-peak macro lights were 2/6 and AD Line hit new highs, U1 held 0 pre-peak puts (zero Call cap drag in 2019's +39% melt-up) and stayed strictly 100% QQQ with ATH<=5% freeze, capturing 100% of the April V-bottom rebound (0.00% excess).
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 零前视客观披露：2020年2月见顶前宏观基本面仅亮 2/6 灯且全美 AD 创历史新高，纯内生宽度/宏观开关未提前挂 Put（也因此零损耗吃满 2019 年 +39% 主升浪）；下跌超 5% 后触发低位铁律冻结，100% 满仓 QQQ 完整吃下 3/23 后的 V 型暴涨（区间超额 0.00%）。

Track-2 Dual-TP (DTE<=45 & Put>=5x) stepped in on 2022-02-24 Open @$318.84 (32 DTE left, 5x+ deep ITM), harvesting +$37,680 (+121.86 extra QQQ shares!) right before March's dead-cat bounce, slashing 2022 MDD from -35.12% to -31.52% (+3.60% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 2022 温水煮青蛙慢熊中 VIX/VIX3M 全年最高仅 1.022（未达 1.10 恐慌倒挂）；第二轨「后半程 DTE<=45 且 Put>=5x」精准补位：在 2022-02-24 早盘 @$318.84（距到期 32 天、深实值超 5 倍）果断兑现 +$37,680（低位抄底 +121.86 股 QQQ），完美避开 3 月底反弹归零，100% 满仓将 2022 回撤从 -35.12% 砍至 -31.52%（超额 +3.60%）！

crisis_windows.title_zh: 2024-08 日元套息交易平仓闪崩 (-13.6%)
crisis_windows.narrative_en: 4/6 Crisis Lights + AD divergence opened two 50% option slots right into the summer peak ($455.50 on 5/30 and $497.62 on 7/16). When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!

Even with macro lights at only 2/6, US Liquid AD Line < 50DMA top-divergence caught the $539.52 top and opened a 50% Collar on 2025-02-24 @$527.88 (K_P=$475.09). On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!
crisis_windows.narrative_zh: 即便宏观灯仅亮 2 盏，全美 AD Line < 50DMA 顶背离依然死死咬住 $539.52 大顶，于 2/24 @$527.88 开启 50% 保护（K_P=$475.09）；4/07 关税恐慌极值（倒挂 1.234）在 $408.66 铁底单笔暴赚 +$76,729，一把抄底 +187.70 股 QQQ，回撤压至 -16.36%（超额高达 +6.41%）！

Track-2 Dual-TP (DTE<=45 & Put>=5x) stepped in on 2022-02-24 Open @$318.84 (32 DTE left, 5x+ deep ITM), harvesting +$37,680 (+121.86 extra QQQ shares!) right before March's dead-cat bounce, slashing 2022 MDD from -35.12% to -31.52% (+3.60% excess)!

When the Yen carry unwind pushed VIX/VIX3M to 1.144 on 2024-08-05, both slots monetized at $437.23 Open on 8/06 for +$35,158 (+80.39 QQQ shares), slashing DD from -13.56% to -8.05% (+5.51% excess)!

Even with macro lights at only 2/6, US Liquid AD Line < 50DMA top-divergence caught the $539.52 top and opened a 50% Collar on 2025-02-24 @$527.88 (K_P=$475.09). On 2025-04-07 Open @$408.66 (VIX/3M 1.234), that single tranche harvested +$76,729 (+187.70 QQQ shares at the exact bottom!), slashing DD to -16.36% (+6.41% excess)!
